measurement_notes: Full real model matches, standard30-card/30HP rules; no altered resource rules.
Each ordered pair has equal counts for hero/enemy first, seeds selected deterministically.
AI reads only public opponent board/hero values and its own cards; no bonus resources.
Immutable validated configuration is shared between fresh match instances; first two deterministic repeats use wholly fresh constructors and compare complete final state/event order.
action_net_resonance totals are measured net changes per AI action; automatic effects between actions and cancelling simultaneous gains/spends are not a gross resource-flow accounting.
known_card_energy_paid counts printed successfully played card costs; it excludes relic/tactic costs and automatic gains.
These heuristic AI games do not prove human metagame balance or exhaustive550-card interactions.
Quick strategy mode covers only a ring of fourteen strategy pairs; full mode covers196 ordered strategy pairs. Both include16 ordered starter pairs.

Aggregate verifies every successful shard source binding, disjoint predeclared case sets, exact212 directed pair coverage,848 cases at default sampling, and balanced first sides; it generates no games.
